meaning: The per se branch: the root n cannot not-be (the tertia via node, the weakest sense that suffices); if some c caused n's necessity, then c and n are actual concreta (OPEN), n depends on c (OPEN), and so c grounds n (OPEN), i.e. c is an actual concrete ground of n, which an actual root lacks. Without these premises the branch fails (controls: a box-existent individual whose necessity another causes).
